attribution.title: De Roode Bioscoop, Haarlemmerplein 7, Amsterdam: music theatre in the former cinema of 1913
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell for roofs and back walls (CC BY 4.0): the yellow-ochre brick plein front with white-cased red-sashed windows, red French doors on railed balconies, the segment-arched red entrance, ROODE BIOSCOOP on the fascia, corner pinnacles and the neck gable with its segmental crown; the 2006 brick side block with its rendered shop floor. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
